versions.content: Synchronization constraint on events Type: valid Description: The Timing Extension shall enable on to impose synchronization constraints on two or more timing descrition events. Rationale: While building up systems it is necessary to specify that the occurrence of events shall be synchronous, like in case of a turn signal indicator, anti blocking systems where information from several wheels are important. Use Case: None Dependencies: [RS_TIMEX_00001] Supporting Material: None
